title: Survey Finds Most Indonesians Doubt Future of Red and White Village Cooperatives
desc: Survey results from SMRC show that the public's confidence in the program has dropped by around 18.3 percentage points from November 2025 to July 5-19, 2026.

title: Few young adults receive palliative care as part of advanced cancer treatment
desc: Few young adults receive palliative care (PC) as part of treatment for stage 4 solid tumors or poor-prognosis high-grade brain tumors, according to a research letter published online July 23 in JAMA Network Open.

title: David Tamihere faces two-month wait to find out if he will be retried
desc: David Tamihere will have to wait another two months to find out whether he will be retried over the 1989 murder of two Swedish backpackers in Coromandel.

title: Australian GTA Online players officially blocked by Rockstar from getting rarest vehicle
desc: Rockstar has revoked access to The Diamond Casino & Resort within GTA Online for players in Australia, removing access to the rarest vehicle in the game.
